grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: Weekend Work at the Café
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方雅思考试。先听录音（或读转录稿），然后完成10道题。注意：听力中有自然对话、纠正和干扰信息。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文，证据为英文原文引用。
transcript:
Mia: Hi Tom. How was your weekend?
Tom: Not great. I had to work on Saturday. The café was very busy.
Mia: Oh no. What did you have to do?
Tom: I had to clean the tables and make coffee. I also had to wash the cups.
Mia: Did you have to work on Sunday too?
Tom: No, I didn't. I only worked on Saturday. On Sunday, I stayed at home.
Mia: What do you have to do at the café every day?
Tom: I have to open the café at seven o'clock. I must wear a uniform. I can take a break at noon.
Mia: Can you choose your break time?
Tom: No, I can't. The manager chooses it. But I can listen to music when I clean.
Mia: That's good. Do you have to work next weekend?
Tom: No, I don't. Next weekend is free. I want to visit my family.
Mia: Nice. What time do you start work on weekdays?
Tom: I start at seven. But yesterday I started at eight because I was late.
Mia: Oh, were you in trouble?
Tom: A little. My manager said, 'You must be on time.' So now I leave home early.
Mia: Good idea. And what did you do after work yesterday?
Tom: I went home and cooked dinner. I didn't go out.
Mia: Thanks, Tom. See you tomorrow.

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: have to 和 must 都表示“必须”，can 表示“可以”。have to 常强调客观需要，must 常强调主观义务或规定，can 表示允许或能力。一般现在时表示经常性动作或事实，一般过去时表示过去发生的动作。注意：过去时中 have to 变为 had to。
grammar.example: I had to clean the tables and make coffee.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a past obligation.
options: Yesterday I had to work late.
Yesterday I have to work late.
answers: Yesterday I had to work late.
questions.explanation: 过去时中表示“必须”用 had to。must 和 have to 不用于过去时。
questions.evidence: I had to clean the tables and make coffee.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a present rule.
options: She must wear a uniform every day.
She must wore a uniform every day.
She must wearing a uniform every day.
She must to wear a uniform every day.
answers: She must wear a uniform every day.
questions.explanation: must 后接动词原形，表示现在必须做的事。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about ability or permission.
options: I can take a break at noon.
I can took a break at noon.
I can taking a break at noon.
I can to take a break at noon.
answers: I can take a break at noon.
questions.explanation: can 后接动词原形，表示可以或能够做某事。
questions.evidence: I can take a break at noon.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence contrasting present and past.
options: I start at seven, but yesterday I started at eight.
I start at seven, but yesterday I start at eight.
I started at seven, but yesterday I start at eight.
I start at seven, but yesterday I starting at eight.
answers: I start at seven, but yesterday I started at eight.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常性动作（start at seven），一般过去时表示过去具体动作（started at eight）。
questions.evidence: I start at seven. But yesterday I started at eight because I was late.
